root object
├─ allOf
│  ├─ [0] -> BaseRecord
│  └─ [1] object [closed]
│     └─ active boolean
├─ anyOf
│  ├─ [0] <type unspecified> [required names: "email"]
│  └─ [1] <type unspecified> [required names: "phone"]
├─ oneOf
│  ├─ [0] <type unspecified>
│  │  └─ kind -> #/oneOf/0/$defs/PersonalKind
│  └─ [1] <type unspecified>
│     └─ kind = "business"
└─ not <type unspecified> [required names: "deletedAt"]

Definitions
├─ BaseRecord object
│  └─ id string [required]
└─ #/oneOf/0/$defs/PersonalKind = "personal"
